Run a named or remotely located workflow

Usage:
  wuko run [NAME|URL|GITHUB] [TARGET] [flags]

Arguments:
  [NAME|URL|GITHUB]
      Discovered workflow name, HTTPS URL, or github:owner/repo@ref:path locator; with --file, the positional argument selects a target
  [TARGET]
      Target declared by the selected workflow

Examples:
  wuko run check
  wuko run deploy staging
  wuko run --file ./deploy.yaml staging
  ./generate-workflow | wuko run --file -
  wuko run check --dry-run
  wuko run check --var 'code="123"'
  wuko run bootstrap --yes

Flags:
      --cpus string                      limit aggregate local workflow CPU use in cores (for example 1.5)
      --defaults                         answer every prompt that declares a default with that default
      --dry-run                          validate and print steps without running them
      --env stringArray                  override an environment variable (KEY=value; repeatable)
      --file string                      run a workflow from a file path, or - for stdin
  -h, --help                             help for run
      --memory string                    limit aggregate local workflow memory (for example 512MiB)
      --once                             run immediately once, ignoring a declared cron schedule
      --pick                             select a workflow from a GitHub repository or tree
      --report-json string               write the final execution report as JSON to a path, or - for stdout
      --report-json-include stringSlice  add redacted values to the JSON report (outputs for step outputs, vars for final variables; comma-separated)
      --reporter stringArray             select a run reporter (plain or quiet or github or multiplexer; repeatable; overrides workflow reporter; defaults to plain)
      --var stringArray                  set a workflow variable (key=value; repeatable)
      --var-file stringArray             import workflow variables from a JSON or TOML file (repeatable)
      --yes                              answer every tui_confirm prompt with true

Global Flags:
      --config string           read CLI configuration from a YAML file instead of the current directory
      --debug                   trace workflow loading, validation, and execution to stderr (may expose non-secret configuration)
      --env-loader stringArray  load the invocation environment with auto, none, mise, asdf, or direnv (repeatable)
      --frozen-lockfile         require existing local plugin pins without modifying wuko.lock
      --no-config               ignore CLI configuration, including the default workflow

Behavior:
  Executes trusted workflow code. --file - reads stdin. --dry-run previews without running steps, but loading can execute source resolvers or plugin helpers. --once ignores cron repetition. --yes answers confirmation prompts only; --defaults uses declared prompt defaults. --report-json - reserves stdout for one execution-report schema_version: 2 document and sends workflow output to stderr. Exit status 0 means success, 1 failure, and 130 cancellation.

Related help:
  wuko help
  wuko reference
  wuko reference topic agents
